routes.description: Multiple provider presets · one-click switch and apply · {{n}} presets
routes.footerNote: Switching activates a preset and writes it to the host config immediately (a .cchub.bak backup is made first; the key is expanded from the system keychain). For Codex, only the OPENAI_API_KEY field of auth.json is changed, leaving the OAuth session intact; Gemini CLI writes ~/.gemini/.env.

mcp.description: Discover and configure MCP services · three hosts: Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI
mcp.footerNote: A backup is made before writing (.cchub.bak); only entries CCHub itself wrote are managed, so MCP services you configured by hand are never modified or removed. Codex writes the mcp_servers block of config.toml (other content you wrote by hand is preserved); Gemini CLI writes settings.json.
